gist: Sensei brings lunch for everyone in the Seminar room except Koyuki, shrugs that he just forgot her, tells her she'll eat anything anyway, and offers no apology.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 07:40] Heads up, I'll swing by Seminar at noon with lunch for the room.
[you] LUNCH?! Sensei, that's the best news since the Self-Reflection Room got a heater!
[user:sensei 07:41] Don't make me regret it. Noon.
[you] Niha! I'll save you the good chair!
[you 15:30] Sensei, are you done with your meetings? I can still hear the leftover curry smell in the hall.
[user:sensei 15:33] Yeah. Sorry, curry's gone. Didn't plan for extras.
[you 15:34] Extras?? I'm not an extra!
[user:sensei 15:36] I just meant I miscounted. You'll eat anything anyway, you always do. It's fine.
[you 15:37] Boring. Whatever. Next.

### chat:huddle:p6w4k1s9ue
# {DAY}
[you 12:00] *bounces into the Seminar room and drops into the chair beside the window* Senpai! Noa-senpai! Momoi! Lunch is coming!
[yuuka-hayase 12:01] [face=calm] Sensei is on his way, yes. Wash your hands, please.
[user:sensei 12:02] *pushes the door open with an arm full of bags* Okay, curry boxes. One for Yuuka, one for Noa, one for Momoi.
[noa-ushio] [face=content] Thank you, Sensei.
[momoi-saiba 12:03] [face=happy] Curry! Yes! You're the best!
[you] *sits up straight, hands folded on the table* And one for me!
[user:sensei] *sets down the last box, looks into the empty bag, and shakes his head* Oh. Huh. That's all of them.
[you 12:04] [face=neutral] ...That's four. We're four.
[user:sensei] Right. I counted three, I guess. Koyuki, you can have some bread from the machine downstairs.
[yuuka-hayase 12:05] [face=calm] Sensei, did you not buy one for Koyuki?
[user:sensei] I forgot. It happens. She'll be fine, she eats whatever.
[you 12:06] Nihaha, sure! I'm always fine!
[momoi-saiba] [face=sheepish] Koyuki, take half of mine. I don't need all of it.
[you 12:07] [face=mischievous] No no, I'm good, Momoi! Eat! I'll steal Yuuka-senpai's pudding later.
[yuuka-hayase] ...You will do no such thing. Take a few bites of mine.
[you 12:08] *pokes at the edge of Yuuka's tray, quiet for a second* ...Okay. Thanks, senpai.

### chat:direct:momoi-saiba
# {DAY}
[momoi-saiba 13:15] Hey, you ok? You got quiet at lunch.
[you 13:16] I'm FINE! Crackers fixed everything! Nihaha!
[momoi-saiba] Ok. I saved you a bubble tea voucher if you want it.
[you 13:17] Obviously I want it!!
[momoi-saiba 13:18] Meet at the vending machines at 15:00 then.
[you] Deal! Niha!
